contract: An authenticated admin socket subscribes by emitting set_log_listener(level); from then on the server emits a `log` event to that socket for every log record at level >= the subscribed level (FATAL always). The event has one argument: an object with string timestamp YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS, string source File.js:line, string message, string levelName and numeric level. Only the subscribing socket receives the event. remove_log_listener stops delivery. A non-admin socket and an invalid level never subscribe.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the log subscription has no force/override mode; a client resubscribes or removes its listener instead.

invariants.contract: A root socket that sent set_log_listener(2) receives a `log` event for a subsequent INFO server log, with one argument object containing string timestamp, string source, the message text, levelName INFO and numeric level 2; a root socket that did not subscribe receives no log event; a socket subscribed at WARN (3) receives no INFO ping event but receives the WARN record produced by an invalid set_log_listener level, and resubscribing at TRACE (0) delivers successive INFO ping events.

Only an admin socket with a valid LogLevel integer subscribes: a listener (non-admin) set_log_listener(0) delivers no log events, a root socket with level 99 receives neither the WARN it caused nor later INFO events, and remove_log_listener stops delivery to a socket that previously received events.
